ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; the visible ventral surface is dominated by low-intensity black pixels (>95%) with high-intensity white pixels restricted to localized scarring and calcified growths.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity black pigmentation across both lobes. Discrete high-contrast circular and ring-shaped blobs are scattered across the central and lateral regions of both lobes, representing localized depigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees, showing a narrow, deep focal point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. Amplitude increases significantly at the lateral tips where pixel-heavy calcified clusters distort the natural linear edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve from the median notch to the lateral tips, terminating in sharp, upward-sloping points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of high-contrast circular ring clusters (white outlines on black background) distributed across the mid-section of both lobes, concentrated heavily on the left lobe lower quadrant and right lobe central quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned vertical and diagonal high-contrast linear disruptions (rake marks) visible on the lower section of the right lobe and middle section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle clusters (Coronula diadema) present on the extreme lateral tips and intermittently along the lower trailing edge; numerous circular 'moon' scars indicating previous parasitic attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, bulbous calcified growth on the very ends of the fluke tips, altering the standard geometric taper of the lobes.
